Use sixteen hidden units, 49 real parameters, seeds 8401–8403, 64 training points and 257 separate evaluation points. Use periodic heat flow uₜ=νuₓₓ on [0,2π) to T=0.25. Split 46 whole problems into 24 training, 6 validation, 8 held-out ID, 4 viscosity-OOD and 4 spectrum-OOD problems. Use two fixed seeds and 93 real parameters. Scope and remaining work This fixed-budget study covers one smooth Poisson problem and three seeds. A small training loss does not establish independent-point accuracy or general PINN training success. Unmet goals remain visible. This comparison concerns a fixed tiny discrete operator, without arbitrary-resolution, distributional or OOD guarantees. The N=64-to-32 discrepancy includes nonlinear aliasing and is not a continuum discretization error. Optimizer convergence is distinct from normal budget termination.
